name: Beyond Finance
desc:
Customer Service Representative | $19 to $20/hr | Inbound and Outbound Client Support, No Sales Expectations
Company: Beyond Finance
Industry: Customer Service

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Beyond Finance helps people get out of debt through financial hardship programs. In this role, you're the main point of contact for clients already enrolled, and you guide them from the day they join until they finish the program. You'll handle a high volume of inbound and outbound calls, answer questions, explain how the program works, and try to solve problems on the first call. You'll look up information across several computer systems at once, keep notes in the CRM, and work with other teams to get answers. You'll help keep clients in the program by giving them great service, and you'll start with four weeks of paid training to learn the programs.

Soft Skills
- Patience and empathy
- Active listening
- Problem solving
- Staying positive with stressed callers
- Time management
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: At least 1 year of call center experience
Preferred Experience: Bilingual English and Spanish

Required Skills:
- Strong computer skills and the ability to learn complex systems
- Excellent written, verbal, and listening skills
- Patience, empathy, and kindness with customers
- Handling routine and complex client questions on your own
- Time management and organization
- Reliable high-speed internet with an ethernet connection
- A distraction-free home workspace

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has a year or more of call center experience
- Wants to help people who are working their way out of debt
- Stays calm and kind when callers are stressed about money
- Is comfortable working in several computer systems at once

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has less than 1 year of call center experience
- Finds money conversations with stressed people draining
- Doesn't have ethernet internet or a quiet workspace
- Wants a low-volume phone job
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Call center
- Customer service
- Inbound and outbound calls
- First call resolution
- Client retention
- CRM documentation
- Active listening
- Financial services
- Troubleshooting
- Bilingual Spanish

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your call center experience.
- A client is frustrated and wants to leave the program. How do you handle the call?
- How do you keep track of information when you're working in several systems at once?
- Tell us about a time you calmed down an upset customer. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you solved a customer's problem on the first call. What was the issue, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $19 to $20/hr.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: For eligible full-time employees: employer contributions for health, dental, and vision, generous PTO, paid holidays, paid parental leave, 401(k) match, merit advancement, and career development.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ethernet internet is required. Ask about equipment in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Not mentioned, recruiter will discuss. Our notes show they do not test for THC.
-Notes: This is a steadier customer service role than Beyond Finance's earlier Client Retention posting, with no commission or sales experience required. Training is four weeks. Strong pay for a call center role with 1 year of experience. Camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Customer Service Representative → Senior Client Success Specialist → Team Lead → Client Success Manager. This role builds financial services, call handling, and client relationship skills.
training: 4 weeks; schedule discussed in interview/offer stage, have open availability
